beats.say: What if the internet shut off… forever?
In one second, eight billion phones go black.
No videos. No maps. No messages.
Traffic lights go crazy… and the city crashes.
By day two, people raid the supermarkets.
By day five, the shelves are empty.
Phones are worthless. Water is the new money.
Kids go outside… and have no idea what to do.
Would you last one week without internet?
